project.title: Vampire: The Masquerade Character Creator
project.summary: A browser-based Vampire: The Masquerade V5 creator with the named Core clans, Caitiff, Thin-bloods, an opt-in Player’s Guide pack, post-creation XP advancement, chronicle presets, a searchable table reference, and a Character Relationship Map.

items.title: Add a coterie and Domain planner with a portable handoff
items.notes: Build on the single-character Relationship Map. Organize several characters and their shared coterie and Domain details in a named browser-local plan. Verify a reviewable portable handoff, a plan round-trip, and that individual character drafts remain intact.
